implementation_summary: Implemented offline relia distill, relia review, and relia memory command paths.
Added deterministic signature clustering for avoid and playbook rule drafts.
Added confidence scoring from evidence count, recency half-life, contradictions, flake discounts, and extraction confidence with drafting_model_weight fixed at 0.
Added stale-path and contradiction lifecycle handling plus review-gated activation.
Rendered memory/MEMORY.md with statements, confidence, lifecycle status, review labels, and clickable PR provenance.
Addressed Codex review feedback by making avoid-rule contradiction timing compare positive evidence against the latest summarized failure.
Quoted generated YAML scalars containing colon-space and added regression tests.
